# kcore_postgresql (Resource)

One PostgreSQL database from the NixOS `services.postgresql` module (`kctl apply -f` with `kind: PostgreSQL`). v1 is a single database per node, reached through the local Unix socket. Only `port` can change in place. Destroy removes the database from the node configuration and leaves `/var/lib/postgresql` on disk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_postgresql" "app" {
  name        = "app"
  package     = "postgresql_16"
  port        = 5432
  target_node = "node-105"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Instance name.

### Optional

- `database` (String) Database name. Defaults to `name` when `name` is a PostgreSQL identifier.
- `package` (String) Nixpkgs attribute: postgresql, postgresql_14, postgresql_15, postgresql_16, postgresql_17. Defaults to `postgresql`.
- `port` (Number) TCP port. Can change in place.
- `target_node` (String) Node that runs the database. The scheduler picks one when empty.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_id` (String) Node the controller placed the database on.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import kcore_postgresql.app app
```
